cases.title: East Coast, 4 May 2022: the Day 5 forecast that busted

narrative.setup: On 4 May 2022 at 00Z the ensemble issued its Day 5 outlook for East Coast.
narrative.flag: Vishwas put the bust probability at 18%, against a climatological rate of about 5%.
narrative.why: See the drivers panel: the note explains which ensemble signals raised the risk.
narrative.outcome: The verifying analysis showed an error of 134 m² s⁻², above the 118 threshold for this region, lead and season. It busted.

cases.title: West Coast, 21 January 2022: a Day 8 forecast worth trusting

narrative.setup: On 21 January 2022 at 00Z the ensemble issued its Day 8 outlook for West Coast.
narrative.flag: Vishwas put the bust probability at 2%: high confidence.
narrative.why: Spread was ordinary for the season, successive runs agreed, and the ensemble formed one coherent scenario.
narrative.outcome: The verifying analysis showed an error of 4 m² s⁻², well inside the 162 threshold. The forecast held.
